question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: the 2026-09-20 thirteen-tool sweep re-run exactly, same merchant endpoint and the same vendor-published example agent profile; then five search_catalog calls across both servers that vary only meta['ucp-agent'].profile. No Authorization header, no HTTP signature, no payment. Nothing was created, cancelled or completed

decoded.gate-unchanged: the 2026-09-20 result reproduces tool for tool nine days later at 06:22Z: complete_checkout and get_order answer HTTP 403 with JSON-RPC error -32000 AuthenticationRequired; the other eleven answer HTTP 200 with isError true and 'Missing required arguments: <names>', naming the argument each wants (id, checkout, cart, catalog). Same endpoint, same profile, same eleven and same two
decoded.a-keyless-search-succeeds: the entry's 2026-09-11 reading reproduces eighteen days on at 06:26Z. With the vendor's own published example profile and a query, search_catalog on the global catalog server answers HTTP 200 with ten products, their titles, prices in minor units, ratings and merchant ids, and a ucp block naming the capabilities served (dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search, dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup, dev.shopify.catalog.global) with status success. No credential, no account, no signature. This is not new to the entry, which recorded the same call and the same ten-product answer on 2026-09-11; what is new is the date
decoded.profile-stage: the agent profile is discovered before arguments are validated and after the credential check, and the server fetches the document rather than only parsing the URL. Omit the field and both servers answer HTTP 422, JSON-RPC -32001 'UCP discovery failed', data.code invalid_profile_url, 'Unable to fetch agent profile: Missing profile uri', even when the call carries a valid query; that outcome the entry has carried since 2026-09-11 for the catalog server and this reading adds a merchant endpoint to it. Point the field at a URL that serves HTML (this reporter's own homepage) and both answer HTTP 422, -32001, data.code profile_malformed, 'Unable to fetch agent profile: Invalid content type'. That third outcome is new to this entry, and it is what shows the fetch happens: a malformed profile is distinguished from a missing one, by content type, at the server. The two credential-gated tools answer 403 before any of it
decoded.servers: catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp initialize 200, serverInfo universal-ucp-mcp 0.1.0; hardware.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp initialize 200, serverInfo universal-commerce 0.1.0; both unchanged from 2026-09-28 and from what the entry records
decoded.a-correction-of-this-reporter's-first-pa: the first thirteen calls of the day (Part A) carried EMPTY arguments with no profile field and answered 422 invalid_profile_url, which read as a change since 2026-09-20 and was not one: the 2026-09-20 pass supplied the example profile and this one had not. The reading was re-run with the earlier pass's own reproducer before anything was written. Both passes are in the artifact, because a reader checking this record should be able to see the request that produced the wrong reading as well as the one that produced the right one
decoded.not-measured: no purchase, no cart, no checkout and no order: every call either carried no arguments or a search query. What the eleven ungated tools do with valid arguments other than search_catalog was not tested, and one merchant endpoint is one merchant's configuration

finding: Re-run nine days on with the 2026-09-20 pass's own reproducer, one merchant's UCP endpoint answers exactly as it did: complete_checkout and get_order refuse an anonymous caller with 403 AuthenticationRequired, the other eleven take the call and answer 'Missing required arguments'. The entry's 2026-09-11 catalog reading also reproduces, eighteen days on: a keyless search_catalog carrying the vendor's published example agent profile answers 200 with ten products, and the same call with no profile answers 422 invalid_profile_url. One outcome is new to this entry. A profile URI that resolves to an HTML page answers 422 with data.code profile_malformed, 'Invalid content type', which distinguishes a malformed profile from a missing one and shows the server fetches the document the field names rather than only parsing the URL. A profile is a document a caller publishes, not an account, so noAccountNeeded is unaffected. One IP, one merchant, one minute.

reproducibility.command: A='{"meta":{"ucp-agent":{"profile":"https://shopify.dev/ucp/agent-profiles/examples/2026-08-25/valid-with-capabilities.json"}},"catalog":{"query":"coffee beans"}}'; curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' -X POST https://catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":9,\"method\":\"tools/call\",\"params\":{\"name\":\"search_catalog\",\"arguments\":$A}}"  # drop the meta block for the first 422; point profile at any HTML page for the second; the thirteen-tool sweep is the command in p-20260920-shopify-ucp-tool-auth-gate
